hip_check: Independent Newington-Gage/Davis formula using LASI RASI SACR or mean PSIS, C3D anthropometry; zero AsisTrocanterDistance replaced per documented formula; marker radius7mm from source paper. No fitting to FEP. Missing parameters remain unchecked.
gdi_recipe: Original 2008 workbook basis/center/logdistance mean/sampleSD; 9 variables pelvisXYZ hipXYZ kneeX ankleX footprogressZ; side-specific variables; 51 linear samples across consecutive ipsilateral Foot Strike events
gdi_primary: Mean of all eligible cycle GDI values per side. Secondary score of mean angle curve also reported, not selected by closest match.
event_alignment: round(event seconds * rate) minus C3D first frame (one-based field); require both events inside acquired range; no completion of partial cycles. +1 sample shift is a separate alignment diagnostic, not automatic replacement.
gdi_reference_age: Original pediatric control reference; not the 65plus40 reference; not interchangeable
label_acceptance: Replay alone is not clinical validity. Record both metadata namespaces; do not pick by model prediction or function correlation.
source_identity: Same six IDs and all three dynamic trials; static files for metadata only; no new participants
